steps.title: Mr. Okafor: Old Town lease explanation · part 1
steps.detail: Mr. Okafor asks for a Old Town lease explanation. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Mr. Okafor: Old Town lease explanation · part 2
steps.detail: The Old Town lease explanation now has conflicting notes. Mr. Okafor wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Mr. Okafor: Old Town lease explanation · part 3
steps.detail: Mr. Okafor is ready to introduce a paying client for the Old Town lease explanation. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented Old Town lease explanation. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Mr. Okafor.
